common.tagline: Create once. Control always. Share anywhere.

landing.title: Your child's care information, created once and shared with whoever you choose.
landing.subtitle: Allergies, medication, emergency contacts, routines and what calms them down. One profile that travels with your child to daycare, school, camp or the babysitter — always under your control.

create.title: Create once
create.body: Stop repeating the same information on every form. Write it once and keep it current.

control.title: Control always
control.body: Decide what each access can see and until when, and revoke it in one click. See who viewed what and when.

share.title: Share anywhere
share.body: A link or a QR code with what the babysitter or teacher needs, on their phone, no sign-up required.

one.title: Complete the profile
one.body: Start with what matters: safety, food, sleep and comfort. Fill in the rest whenever you want.

two.title: Choose what to share
two.body: Family, babysitter or institution: each access shows only what is needed and expires automatically.

three.title: They review, you see who
three.body: The caregiver confirms they reviewed the critical information. You get the access log.

landing.institutionsBody: Receive complete, family-maintained profiles with verifiable consent and read confirmations for critical information. No paper forms.
landing.trustNote: Information is shared only with the people you authorize, for the time you define, and every access is logged.
landing.whoSubtitle: You choose per kind of access. Critical information always comes first; the rest only if you share it.

family.title: Grandparents and family
family.body: Emergency, allergies, medication, food, sleep and comfort. No expiration, or the one you set.

babysitter.title: Babysitter
babysitter.body: Only what tonight needs, with a PIN if you want, and the link stops working when it is over.

institution.title: Daycare or school
institution.body: What the team needs, with read confirmation of the critical parts. They propose; you decide.

assurance.revoke: Revoke any access in one click; the link stops working instantly.
assurance.expire: Every access can expire on its own, without you having to remember.
assurance.log: Every view is logged: who, what and when.
assurance.ack: Caregivers confirm they read the critical information before starting.
assurance.change: When something important changes, caregivers see it flagged as new.
assurance.truth: The family is the only source of truth: nobody edits the profile for you.

institutionsPoints.ready: Know which children have allergies, medication and contacts up to date.
institutionsPoints.rooms: Each teacher sees only the children of their room.
institutionsPoints.propose: Propose observations; the family accepts or rejects them.
institutionsPoints.consent: Dated consent and a reading log for every child.

profile.title: Care profile

HEALTH.name: Health
HEALTH.description: Allergies, medication, conditions, vaccines and instructions.

NUTRITION.name: Food
NUTRITION.description: What they eat, what not, and their routine.

COMMUNICATION.name: Communication
COMMUNICATION.description: How they express needs and ask for help.

COMFORT.name: Comfort
COMFORT.description: What calms them and what may upset them.

SOCIAL.name: Social interaction
SOCIAL.description: Observations about how they relate, without labels.

fields.label: Title
fields.detailsHint: Clear instructions for whoever cares for them.

actions.deleteConfirm: Remove this item from the profile?

empty.EMERGENCY: Add at least one emergency contact. It is the first thing any caregiver sees.
empty.HEALTH: Allergies, medication or medical instructions? Record them here.
empty.NUTRITION: What they can eat, what not, and how meals go.
empty.SLEEP: Nap times, bedtime routine and objects they need.
empty.COMMUNICATION: Words they use, how they ask for help, non-verbal cues.
empty.COMFORT: What calms them and which situations may upset them.
empty.PLAY: Their favorite toys, characters, music and activities.
empty.SOCIAL: Contextual observations about how they relate. Avoid labels.

profile.socialGuidance: Describe situations, not traits. For example: "In new environments they usually observe before joining". Avoid words like "isolated" or "unsociable".

visibleTo.title: Who can see this?
visibleTo.nobody: Nobody else has access to this section.

assistant.title: Assistant to structure information
assistant.hint: Write in your own words. We will propose structured data; you decide what to save.
assistant.placeholder: Example: Mateo cannot eat peanuts, usually naps at two, and looks for his blue dinosaur when nervous.
assistant.nothingFound: We found nothing to structure. Try more concrete sentences.
assistant.disclaimer: The assistant does not diagnose or assess. It only organizes what you write.

readiness.title: Ready for care
readiness.hint: The minimum any caregiver needs to know. Saying "none" counts too.
readiness.enrichmentHint: Routines, communication, comfort and interests: optional, but they help care better.

descriptions.BABYSITTER: Temporary access for an evening or a few days.
descriptions.INSTITUTION: Daycare, kindergarten, school, academy. Receives the profile and can propose observations.
